List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 18, 2005/Sravana 27, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy; Coal;
Communications and Information Technology; External Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Ocean Development; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel, Public

Planetarium in Rampur district of
Uttar Pradesh
†*341. SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH: Will the Minister of SCIENCE
AND TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Uttar Pradesh has sent a proposal for
establishing a planetarium in Rampur
district of Uttar Pradesh; and
(b) if so, the action taken by
Government in this regard?
Expansion of UN Security Council
*342. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH : Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the latest position in relation to the
expansion of the UN Security Council;
(b) whether Government have been
assured of full support from the P-5;
(c) whether Government have been able
to muster support in relation to this in the
UN General Assembly; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Indian astronaut in US Space
Shuttle
*343. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the USA is examining to
include an Indian astronaut in their training
programme who would board the US-
manned space vehicle, Space Shuttle;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the status
of the proposal; and
(c) the details of the Indo-US initiatives
on space programmes in the recent years?
NH Project running behind schedule
*344. SHRI VEDPRAKASH P.
GOYAL: Will the Minister of SHIPPING,
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

108
on-going national highway projects are
running behind the scheduled time;
(b) the details of such projects and the
reasons for delay, project-wise;
(c) to what extent the construction cost
of each such project has been increased due
to delay;
(d) the details thereof; and
(e) in what manner Government
propose to meet the deadlines?
Unfair labour practices by big
factories in NCR
†*345. SHRI DARA SINGH
CHAUHAN: Will the Minister of
LABOUR AND EMPLOYMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that big factories situated in Delhi
and NCR bring hundreds of labourers from
Bihar, Eastern UP, Orissa, Uttaranchal and
Nepal and force them to work as bonded
labourers throughout the year and send
them back to their States after paying them
a meagre amount;
(b) whether it is a fact that the reputed
companies are also involved in the racket;
(c) whether Government would make
an effort to know the facts by conducting a
sincere enquiry into this matter;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Debt burden of States
*346. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Kerala
Government's debt burden has risen to
Rs. 41,709 crores as on 31st March, 2005;
(b) the action plan of the Centre to help
the State to tackle its financial problems;
and
(c) the action plan of Government to
help the Orissa State which is also under
unsustainable debt?
Showing of Indian areas in Pakistan's
map
†*347. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some parts
of Jammu and Kashmir in the map of the
country are repeatedly displayed as
Pakistan's part and this blunder is frequently
committed by Government offices;
(b) if so, the action being taken by
Government on such serious issue;
(c) whether any company or
Government office can commit such a
blunder in drawing Indian map and display
the same on the computer; and
(d) if not, the details of the action taken
in this regard?
Regularisation of casual workers
*348. SHRI KARNENDU
BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
hundreds of casual workers working for
several years under various divisions of
CGM, BSNL in the country, particularly
in North Eastern Region; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

109
(b) if so, what is Government's stand to
make these ill fated casual workers
regular?
Increase of child labour
†*349. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the number of child
labourers has increased during the last three
years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have decided
to enact new laws to check child labour;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Employment through employment
exchanges
†*350. SHRI JANARDAN
DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons whose names
are registered with various employment
exchanges in the country, State-wise and
category-wise;
(b) the number of persons who have
got employment through employment
exchanges since, the year 2000; State-wise
and category-wise; and
(c) the amount spent on salaries etc. of
employees and officers working in
employment exchanges and their
maintenance, so far, since 2000 and utility
of such employment exchanges?
CBI raids against civil servants
*351. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) the number of  I.A.S., I.P.S. and I.R.S.
officers who have been raided by C.B.I.
during last five years;
(b) how many cases have been
registered against these officers on the basis
of these raids;
(c) how many have been challaned out
of above cases;
(d) how many have been convicted out
of challaned cases;
(e) what conclusions Government draw
from above statistics regarding corruption
scenario in above elite services; and
(f) what steps Government intend to
take to improve the situation?
Highway connecting Jalandhar to
Amritsar
†*352. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING, ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the highway
connecting Jalandhar to Amritsar is a narrow
one and it is planned to be widened;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme;
(c) whether it is also a fact that in view
of the indications of increasing trade with
Pakistan, there is a need to pay special
attention on this stretch of National
Highway; and
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

110
(d) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard and by when this stretch of the
road is targeted to be widened?
Release of Indian and Pakistani
fishermen
†*353. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI LEKHRAJ BACHANI:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Pakistani fishermen
released by Government from January,
2004 to April, 2005;
(b) the number of Indian fishermen
released by Government of Pakistan during
the said period;
(c) whether India has returned the boats
of Pakistani fishermen to them, if so, the
details thereof; and
(d) the number of Indian fishermen
whose boats have been returned to them
by Pakistan?
Agricultural workers
*354. SHRI BALAVANT ALIAS
BAL APTE:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether agricultural sector employs
more persons than any other sector, both
as farmers and agricultural workers;
(b) if so, the total number of agricultural
workers in the country, State-wise; and
(c) the details of various Central welfare
schemes for agricultural workers?
Coal shortage
*355. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is an acute shortage of
coal in the country at present;
(b) if so, what steps Government
propose to ensure that no wastage of the
commodity takes place;
(c) whether there is any proposal to
import coal to tide over the situation; and
(d) if so, the sources thereof and the
likely cost per metric tonne at which it
would be available in the country; including
insurance and freight?
Utilisation of fund allocated for the
protective works
*356. SHRI R. KAMARAJ: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that less than 40
per cent of funds allocated for the protective
works during the first three years of the
Tenth Plan have been utilized by the coal
companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have directed
the coal companies that all the schemes
approved by DDCA Committee are
completed in a time bound programme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pace of National Highway
construction
*357. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
SHIPPING, ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the pace of
National Highway construction has
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

111
accelerated to 7.5 km a day and committed
to fast-track development of infrastructure,
especially roads and ports by creating more
jobs;
(b) if so, the present position of the
construction of each National Highway;
(c) the amount spent for each Highway;
and
(d) the details of the employment
provided in each category, highway-wise?
Grants for sports infrastructure
*358. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the maximum amount of fund
provided under 'Grants for creation of
Sports Infrastructure' and 'Grants for
Installation of Synthetic Playing Surfaces'
Schemes;
(b) the details of funds provided during
the last three years to NGOs, State-wise;
and
(c) whether Government would provide
funds to more NGOs in the country for
developing sports infrastructure to develop
sports spirit in the youth?
Registration of Trade Unions
†*359. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether in view of the incident of
Gurgaon, Government are considering to
make changes in the labour laws;
(b) the details of the existing law
regarding registration of 'trade unions', and
the steps being taken by Government to
make the registration mandatory; and
(c) whether Government have any
information about the number of trade
unions of the employees working in
multinational companies?
Outsourcing of Research and
Development
*360. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the integration of India and
China into global economy and consequent
increase in outsourcing of research and
development to these nations have not only
made revolutionary impact on the cost of
drug development in west but also helped
reshape domestic industries in both the
nations;
(b) whether as per the recent findings in
the 19th Annual Global Biotechnology
meet, India and China are improving their
regulatory systems;
(c) if so, whether recently both countries
have seen a boost in intellectual property
protection, with amendment in India's
Patents law in 2005; and
(d) to what extent both countries have
agreed to play a greater role in
Biotechnology?
NEW DELHI; YOGENDRA NARAIN,
The 12th August, 2005 Secretary-General.

Pradhan Mantri Rozgar Yojana in Uttar
Pradesh during the last three years, year-
wise;

been sanctioned loans by banks during the

electricity from different nuclear power

atomic power stations, besides Hydel

(b) whether industrialized countries

Government for this?

CHANDRAN: Will the PRIME

setting up a Synthetic Rutile Plant at
Chavara, Kollam District;
(b) whether application of IREL for
extension of mining lease for 20 years to
ensure required raw material for the project
has been approved by the Kerala
Government;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) whether KMML has agreed for the
tie-up with the project for using the

pigment expansion; and

Uranium reserves in Himachal
Pradesh

state:

indication of uranium reserve in Jakhuni
village of Kangra district in Himachal
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
for its confirmation; and
(c) by when it would be confirmed?

investment in the coal mining in some foreign
countries;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard and the
names of the countries the proposals of
which are still under consideration for
making investment in the coal mining;
(c) the maximum amount proposed to
be invested therein; and
(d) the reasons for giving  priority to
the foreign mining instead of domestic
mining?
Gevra Opencast expansion project
2517. SHRI  RAASHID ALVI:
 DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have approved
the Gevra Opencast expansion project of
the South Eastern Coalfields Limited;
(b) if so, whether the total capital
investment is of Rs. 1,667.55 crores;
(c) if so, whether the completion cost
would be Rs. 1,897.80 crores;
(d) the total production of tonnes of
coal to be purchased from this project;
(e) the period of completion of this
project;
(f) to what extent, it would raise coal
output; and
(g) the States where the coal would be
supplied from this project?
Setting up coal-based pithead power
plant in Orissa
2518. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:

Lignite Corporation proposes to set up a
coal-based pithead power plant in Orissa
in joint venture;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of power that would be
generated by this plant; and
(d) how far would  this help to bridge
the gap between demand and supply of
power in Orissa?

unions

companies have taken a decision to
rehabilitate wards of deceased workers?
Import of coal

PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:

requirement of power companies and other
industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the quantity and grade of coal to be
imported and from which countries;
(d) the efforts made by Coal India to
increase production of good quality coal in
the country; and
(e) if so, the results thereof?

Department of forest
†2521. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to non-
clearance of approval under the Forest
(Conservation) Act, 1980, there has been a
shortfall in the  production of coal of around
27,93,324 tonnes by the Mahanadi
Coalfield Limited from the last April to
February this year;
(b) if so, whether it is also a fact that
State Government, Mahanadi Coalfields
Limited and Central Government suffered
a loss of Rupees, 23,74,35,000/-
118,25,10,000/- and 25,89,99,000/-
respectively; and
(c) who is responsible for this loss and
concrete measures taken by Government
for stopping the recurrence of the same?
Policy to allot coal for captive use

the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are contemplating a change in the present
policy of providing coal for captive use
through coal linkage;
(b) if so, whether the new policy would
also be applicable to the companies which
already have availed coal linkage;
(c) if so, whether it would make coal
costlier for small companies; and
(d) if so, how would small companies
compete market system with the big
companies which have received coal block?

MISHRA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether due to mining work carried
out in the coal areas of Jharkhand, the threat

(b) if so, whether Government have
made any scientific study to determine the
area affected by this mining work and the
details thereof;

sliding during the last four years and the

accidents; and
(d) the steps being taken by
Government to prevent these accidents and
the details thereof?

CHAUHAN: Will the PRIME MINISTER

(a) whether it is a fact that some mines
of Bharat Coking Coal Limited and Central
Coal Field Limited have caught fire for
decades;
(b) if so, the total number of sites caught
fire and since when the sites caught fire
alongwith reasons therefor;

(c) whether his Ministry has claimed
that these fires would soon be brought under
control; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to extinguish

BAGRODIA:
SHRI K.B.KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:

been major deficiencies on the part of the

SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that out of 83,304
workers engaged in Coal Mines by
contractors, 52, 304 remained uncovered
up to March, 2003 by the Coal Mines
Provident Fund Organisation (CMPFO);
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
CMPFO failed to exercise its powers to
realize outstanding dues amounting to
Rs. 314.22 crores on account of PF and
pension arrears; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and reasons
therefor?
Common Service Centre in Andhra
Pradesh
2527. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Postal
Department proposes to Start Common
Service Centres to issue Birth and Death
certificates;
(b) whether it is also true that one lakh
such centres are proposed in different parts
of the country;
(c) if so, the number of Common  Service
Centres proposed to start in the State of
Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) whether Government think of adding
some value added services to the proposed
centres?
Setting up of Hardware Park
2528. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to set up a Hardware Park near
Bangalore International Airport in
Karnataka;
(b) if so, whether the Karnataka
Government have sought financial
assistance;

373
(c) if so, the amount of financial
assistance sought for;
(d) whether Karnataka Government
have also sought declaring the proposed
park as Special Economic Zone; and
(e) if so, the action, if any, taken in this
regard?
PCO facilities in Nagaland
2529. SHRI T.R. ZELIANG: Will the
Minister of COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
